name: Cecilia Amberton
original_name: セシリア·アンバートン
source:
The sole heir of the Amberton Earl family.
From childhood, she has adored Christopher to the point of ignoring all others, and now she’s found herself left behind in the race for marriage.
Desperate to secure Christopher’s hand and restore her family’s honor, she even resorted to summoning the demon Alma.

Bright and determined, Cecilia isn’t foolish—but her sense of what’s “proper” for a noble lady is a little… unconventional.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/gakereijou/character/]the official website[/url].]
